title: Building OrcaTrading, here's our screener.
author: No_Page5992
selftext:
Hey everyone, 

I am the founder of OrcaTrading.  
A start-up in which our main goal is to make trading more accessible for everyone.

One of our main products is our screener.  
Not the usual one, but one that tells you if the market you are watching right now, is actually worth trading or not.  
Something many people seem to forget is actual in-depth market conditions.  
This screener helps people identify the best markets, in which it leaves you to look for your specific entry criterea, which will multiply your probability of success.

As this is reddit, I'll remain brutally honest, and tell you guys that we do not yet have many users yet.  
This is why I want to share this here, in order for us to receive actual good and honest feedback.

This is not some kind of marketing trick, we genuinely want to receive feedback on what would help YOU improve YOURSELF.  
This is what we need to improve us.

We already have a 7-day free trial for the screener, but for everyone that wants to test this product out for us and would like to give valuable feedback, you will be eligible to request a refund for the entire first month through me, right here.  
Also to prove that I am here for feedback, not marketing!

If you'd like to test the product go ahead and reach out.

My ultimate goal would be to have a strong client -> business bond.  
One of the ways we want to achieve this, is having a community. A client hub.  
Here people can request certain idea's, improvements, or even complete new products.  
Or, give feedback on existing products.

When subscribed to the screener, hit me up here again and enter our exclusive client hub.

Thank you guys!
